        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        for ticker in ["KO", "PEP"]:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker)
            equity.spread = self.spread(equity, "PEP" if ticker == "KO" else "KO")
            # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
            # equity.spread = Spread(0, 0)
            # self.warm_up_indicator(equity, equity.spread, Resolution.DAILY)
            # self.register_indicator(equity, equity.spread, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day("KO"),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open("KO", 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        for security in self.securities.values():
            if not security.ols.is_ready:
                continue
            beta, _ = security.ols.current.value

            other = self.securities.get(security.id.other)
            if not other:
                continue

                    self.set_holdings(other, target)
                continue

            weight = self.portfolio[security].quantity / self.portfolio.total_invested_quantity

            if weight > 0.5 and z > 2:
                self.liquidate(security)
                self.liquidate(other)
                continue

            if weight < -0.5 and z < -2:
                self.liquidate(security)
                self.liquidate(other)
